Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, activities, assays, and target_dictionary linking activities to the target. Filter to target chembl_id CHEMBL1893, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows.
